decisions.reason: After two years of no visible market presence, this peripheral consumer product lacks the strategic importance and sunk industrial investment needed to sustain further commitment.
Despite fitting the core business, its prolonged non-visibility makes it easier to fold the concept back into standard engineering offerings than keep defending it as a distinct line.
As a flagship with substantial development effort and public strategic commitment behind it, management is still inclined to treat weak results as temporary and continue backing it.
Because it remains closely tied to the firm's announced waste-to-value direction, management is likely to persist and explain the lack of visible traction as a timing or market-maturity issue.
